scope: Fixed Alpha Meowstic on the central Wild Zone 9 rooftop only. No exact pin, weather exclusivity, comprehensive roster or boundary signoff. The original Alpha rows and progress keys are retained.

notes: Lv. 41–42. From the Wild Zone 9 fast-travel arrival, go straight to the ladder at the end and climb to the central rooftop.

sources.claim: Two separate fixed Alpha form rows.
Reports male at night and female by day.
Field-observed level and day/night split, with separate in-game stills for the male and female fixed Alphas.
Confirms both forms share the central rooftop, female by day and male at night, and describes the approach from the fast-travel arrival.

notes: Both forms use the same fixed encounter location in different time windows. Exact Atlas placement and weather exclusivity are not established.
